nodes.name: Nickel foam cleaning and phosphorization
nodes.procedure: NFs (2 cm × 3 cm) were degreased by sonication in HCl (3 M) solution for 20 min to remove surface oxides and then rinsed with acetone, ethanol, and isopropanol for 10 min, respectively. Finally, the NFs were dried at 60 °C in the ovens for 12 h. NaH2PO2·H2O (3.0 g) was ground into powder and put in a quartz boat to mix with NFs evenly, and then set at the center of the tube furnace. The furnace was heated to 300 °C (2 °C min⁻¹) and kept for 2 h under N₂ atmosphere. The obtained intermediate product (Ni₁₂P₅) was used for next step.

nodes.name: Mo impregnation and sulfuration
nodes.procedure: The obtained intermediate product (Ni12P5) was immersed into MoCl5 (0.1 m) ethanol solution for 1 h and dried at room temperature, and then heated at 350 °C for another 1 h in N2 atmosphere with sulfur powder supplied upstream. After that, the final product (Mo-NiPx/NiSy) was obtained by centrifugation, after that washed with water and dried.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows nanowire-like morphology of Mo-NiPx/NiSy heterogeneous with nonuniform length varied from 2-10 μm and a diameter of about 150 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The nanowire-like morphology of the Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ heterogeneous is determined by TEM and SEM measurements ... The Mo-NiS_x/NiP_γ nanowires exhibit a nonuniform length varied from 2-10 μm and a diameter of about 150 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms nanowire-like morphology of Mo-NiPx/NiSy heterogeneous.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The nanowire-like morphology of the Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ heterogeneous is determined by TEM and SEM measurements.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows heterogeneous nanostructure with inter-planar spacings of 0.204 nm (Ni2S3 (202)), 0.158 nm (Ni12P5 (332)), 0.216 nm (Ni12P5 (400)), 0.234 nm (Ni12P5 (112)), 0.202 nm (Ni2P (201)), 0.221 nm (Ni2P (111)), and 0.198 nm (Ni17S18).
nodes.evidence_snippet: HRTEM image further demonstrate heterogeneous nanostructure of as-prepared Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ nanowires ... in which the inter-planar spacing of 0.204 nm corresponds to the (202) facet of Ni2S3 species while the d-spacing of 0.158, 0.216, and 0.234 nm are indexed to the (332), (400), and (112) planes of Ni12P5...

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM and elemental mapping show uniform distribution of P, S, Ni, and Mo throughout the entire Mo-NiPx/NiSy nanowire.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Besides, the composition information of the asprepared Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ hetero-nanostructures was determined by high-angle annular dark-field scanning TEM (HAADF-STEM) and corresponding elemental mapping measurements. The elements of P, S, Ni, and Mo are distributed uniformly throughout the entire Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ nanowire.

nodes.characterization_summary: PXRD confirms crystal phases Ni12P5 (JCPDS No. 74-1381), Ni2P (JCPDS No. 74-1385), Ni3S2 (JCPDS No. 44-1418), and Ni17S18 (JCPDS No. 76-2306) in Mo-NiPx/NiSy catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystal phase compositions of the Ni2P/Ni12P5, Ni3S2, NiP_x/NiS_γ, and Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ catalyst are determined by powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) pattern ... indicating the successful synthesis of Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ hetero-nanostructures.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms presence of Ni, S, Mo, O, P elements. Ni 2p peaks at 856.53, 874.5 eV (Ni 2p3/2, 1/2), 852.27, 869.68 eV (metallic Ni), positive shift ≈1.2 eV after Mo doping. Mo 3d peaks at 229.65, 232.45 eV (Mo4+), 235.49 eV (Mo6+). S 2p peaks at 161.75, 162.84 eV with positive shift after Mo doping. P-O at 133.6 eV from surface oxidation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To further understand the chemical identity and detailed chemical and electronic states of Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ, the X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis is measured ... High-resolution spectra of the Ni 2p, Mo 3d, P 2p, and S 2p were further characterized.

nodes.characterization_summary: CV measures double-layer capacitance Cdl = 96 mF cm^{-2} for Mo-NiPx/NiSy, indicating largest ECSA compared to other catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To further understand the mechanism of high effective OER performance of the as-prepared electrode, the electrochemically active surface areas are measured by cyclic voltammetry ... Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ electrode presents the largest C_dl value (96 mF cm^{-2})

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows charge transfer resistance Rct = 0.5 Ω for Mo-NiPx/NiSy, smaller than other catalysts, indicating higher electrical conductivity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Nyquist plots analysis verify that the charge transferring resistance (R_ct) of Mo-NiP_x/NiS_γ (0.5 Ω) is much smaller than pure NF (55 Ω), Ni3S2 (4 Ω), NiP_x/NiS_γ (1.5 Ω)...
